shared.concept_anchor: Community Reserve: consent, ownership, and CRMC authority comprehensive test

en.display_text:
Consider the following statements about Community Reserves under the Wildlife Protection Act, 1972:

1. A Community Reserve can be declared over both community-owned and private land, provided the respective landholders — gram sabha for community land and individual owners for private land — give their consent.
2. After the declaration of a Community Reserve, the State Government acquires ownership of all land within its boundaries and pays compensation to the previous landholders.
3. The Community Reserve Management Committee (CRMC) has the authority to prepare and implement the conservation and management plan for the area, reflecting active community governance over the reserve.

Which of the above statements is/are correct?

(a) 1 and 3 only
(b) 2 and 3 only
(c) 1 and 2 only
(d) 1, 2 and 3

statement_analysis.statement: A Community Reserve can be declared over both community-owned and private land, provided the respective landholders — gram sabha for community land and individual owners for private land — give their consent.
statement_analysis.reason: Chapter IVB of WPA 1972 allows Community Reserve declaration on community or private land; consent from the relevant land-controlling body (gram sabha for community land; community/landowners for private land) is required before declaration.

statement_analysis.statement: After the declaration of a Community Reserve, the State Government acquires ownership of all land within its boundaries and pays compensation to the previous landholders.
statement_analysis.reason: Community Reserve declaration does NOT transfer ownership to the State Government. The community retains ownership of its land; the State cannot compulsorily acquire community land after declaration — this is a defining protection of the Community Reserve framework.

statement_analysis.statement: The Community Reserve Management Committee (CRMC) has the authority to prepare and implement the conservation and management plan for the area, reflecting active community governance over the reserve.
statement_analysis.reason: The CRMC's plan-preparation and implementation authority is the statutory expression of community governance in Community Reserves — a function absent in the advisory Conservation Reserve Management Committee.

en.strong_distractor: d — Option (d) claiming all three statements are correct is the primary trap — Statement 2's confident description of acquisition and compensation sounds like standard protected area law (applicable to National Parks) and may be accepted without scrutiny.
elimination_logic: Verify Statement 1: Community and private land both eligible; consent from gram sabha/landholders required — confirmed under Chapter IVB. Correct.

Critically examine Statement 2: Does Community Reserve declaration transfer ownership to State with compensation? No — community retains ownership. This is the fundamental community empowerment feature. Statement 2 is incorrect.
Verify Statement 3: CRMC prepares and implements management plan — confirmed as CRMC's core authority. Correct.
Statements 1 and 3 correct; Statement 2 incorrect — option (a).
en.upsc_trap_explanation: Statement 2 applies the National Park land acquisition framework (where rights are settled and land effectively vests in the State through Forest Settlement) to Community Reserves. This is the entity-swap trap — the acquisition-and-compensation model belongs to a different protected area category. Community Reserves were explicitly designed to avoid this process by keeping land in community ownership. A candidate who associates 'formal protected area = government land acquisition' will accept Statement 2 as correct.
en.final_explanation:
The Community Reserve framework under WPA 1972 represents a rights-preserving conservation model distinct from the acquisition-based approach of National Parks.

• Statement 1 — Correct: Community Reserve eligibility covers both community-owned and private land. The consent requirement is collective — gram sabha for community land, and community/individual owners for private land. Both categories of land can be included within a single Community Reserve.
• Statement 2 — Incorrect: This statement applies National Park logic to Community Reserves. In National Parks, a settlement process extinguishes or commutes rights and land effectively vests in the Forest Department. Community Reserves are the opposite — no acquisition, no compensation, and no ownership transfer. The State cannot compulsorily acquire community land after declaration.
• Statement 3 — Correct: The CRMC's mandate to prepare and implement the management plan gives the community genuine governance authority over the reserve, not merely consultative participation.

Value Addition:
• The 'no acquisition' design of Community Reserves makes them administratively faster to declare than National Parks or Sanctuaries, which require lengthy rights settlement proceedings.
• This design aligns with IUCN Category VI protected areas — territories where sustainable use and community governance coexist with conservation objectives.
• In states like Kerala, CRMC meetings function similarly to panchayat committee meetings — integrating conservation decisions into existing local governance structures.

1. एक सामुदायिक रिजर्व दोनों सामुदायिक-स्वामित्व वाली और निजी भूमि पर घोषित किया जा सकता है, बशर्ते संबंधित भूमि धारक — सामुदायिक भूमि के लिए ग्राम सभा और निजी भूमि के लिए व्यक्तिगत मालिक — अपनी सहमति दें।

3. सामुदायिक रिजर्व प्रबंधन समिति (CRMC) के पास क्षेत्र के संरक्षण और प्रबंधन योजना तैयार करने और लागू करने का अधिकार होता है, जो रिजर्व पर सक्रिय सामुदायिक शासन को दर्शाता है।

उपरोक्त में से कौन-सा/से कथन सही है/हैं?

(a) केवल 1 और 3
(b) केवल 2 और 3
(c) केवल 1 और 2

hi.final_explanation:
WPA 1972 के तहत सामुदायिक रिजर्व ढांचा अधिकार-संरक्षित संरक्षण मॉडल का प्रतिनिधित्व करता है, जो राष्ट्रीय उद्यानों के अधिग्रहण-आधारित दृष्टिकोण से भिन्न है।

• कथन 1 — सही: सामुदायिक रिजर्व पात्रता में दोनों सामुदायिक-स्वामित्व वाली और निजी भूमि शामिल हैं। सहमति की आवश्यकता सामूहिक है — सामुदायिक भूमि के लिए ग्राम सभा, और निजी भूमि के लिए समुदाय/व्यक्तिगत मालिक। दोनों भूमि श्रेणियाँ एक ही सामुदायिक रिजर्व में शामिल की जा सकती हैं।
• कथन 2 — गलत: यह कथन राष्ट्रीय उद्यान तर्क को सामुदायिक रिजर्व पर लागू करता है। राष्ट्रीय उद्यानों में, एक निपटान प्रक्रिया अधिकारों को समाप्त या परिवर्तित कर देती है और भूमि प्रभावी रूप से वन विभाग को हस्तांतरित हो जाती है। सामुदायिक रिजर्व इसके विपरीत हैं — कोई अधिग्रहण नहीं, कोई मुआवजा नहीं, और कोई स्वामित्व स्थानांतरण नहीं। घोषणा के बाद राज्य सामुदायिक भूमि को जबरन अधिग्रहित नहीं कर सकता।
• कथन 3 — सही: प्रबंधन योजना तैयार करने और लागू करने का CRMC का अधिकार समुदाय को रिजर्व पर वास्तविक शासन अधिकार देता है, केवल सलाहकार भागीदारी नहीं।
